_comment: Skill gates: observable tool events that require skills to have been loaded this session. Single source of truth consumed by the shared core (~/.agents/guardrails/core.ts, createGuardrails) across Claude, Codex, pi, and opencode; matching lives in core.ts, the host adapter supplies session evidence of concrete skill loads. Each gate's `trigger` is one of: {type:bash, command, subcommands?} | {type:write, path_glob, at_root?, except?} | {type:fetch, domains} | {type:capability, all_of}. Every miss fails open. Add a gate here once; all agents pick it up. `message` states ONLY the event that tripped the gate — never what a skill contains; purposes live solely in skill descriptions (avoids cross-source drift).
